Question: I am suffering from epilepsy, for last 2 yrs I am in deep trouble. I use to offer daily prayer at my residence even I avoid to attend in Friday namaz; becoz seizure can occur at any time, I am taking medicine, request for dua n plz reply. Answer ID: 3292 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 301/278=B) Recite the below mentioned dua daily seven times and blow upon you: اس أ ل اللہ العظیم رب العرش العظیم ان یشفینی Also, keep on reciting یا سلام یا سلام as much as you can. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
